_comment: Golden eval cases. Expected values come from Jonathan (baseline/protocol owner); records in evals/fixtures/golden_v1.jsonl (Jonathan's final runner, HARNESS_VERSION 1.0, 10 Oct 2026 IST). status: 'active' = hard gate; 'TODO' = gate is enforced when the pair is in a batch, but a missing pair is not a failure; 'pending' = candidate only, mismatches are warnings and it never fails a run. Per-run counts are the raw pytest summary (per_run[].summary_counts, cross-checked against pytest_summary), never the JUnit counts (JUnit counts xpassed as passed). Counting rules: a collection error counts once per test MODULE as import_failure (never real_break); tests that vanish because their module failed to import are lost_tests. Installed (wheel) packages are tested with pytest --import-mode=prepend.

cases.name: golden-sklearn160rc1-imblearn-import-failure
cases.reference: Jonathan golden record golden-sklearn160rc1-imblearn0124 (box, 10 Oct 2026 IST; imbalanced-learn 0.12.4, numpy 2.1.3, scipy 1.14.1, pandas 2.2.3, Python 3.13.5, wheel tests with --import-mode=prepend). Old side '2238 passed, 33 skipped, 1 xfailed, 5 xpassed' x3; new side '525 errors' x3 = 20 module collection errors + 505 xdist 'failed on setup with CollectError'; 46 test modules fail to import with ImportError: cannot import name '_safe_tags' from 'sklearn.utils._tags' -> import_failure 46, lost_tests 2243 (= 2238 passed + 5 xpassed), real_break 0. Matches the raw reproduction in /workspace/br-repro. Root cause of the earlier 280 failed / 250 passed dev numbers: --import-mode=importlib left imblearn half-imported. Upstream cause: scikit-learn PR #29677; fixed downstream in imbalanced-learn PR #1109.

cases.name: golden-pandas300rc0-upsetplot-cow
cases.reference: pandas 3.0 Copy-on-Write (pandas PR #56633, merge 3b57972c) makes chained assignment in upsetplot/plotting.py a no-op; UpSetPlot issue #303. Environment confirmed by Jonathan: pandas 2.3.3 vs 3.0.0rc0, UpSetPlot 0.9.0 (tests from git tag 0.9.0), numpy 2.3.5, matplotlib 3.10.8, pytest 9.1.1, Python 3.13. 67 real breaks and 6 already broken, unchanged from the calibration run.

cases.name: golden-clean-sklearn151-152-imblearn
cases.reference: Clean pair, promoted from candidate on 10 Oct 2026 after Jonathan's verified run: scikit-learn 1.5.1 -> 1.5.2 (patch release), imbalanced-learn 0.12.4, numpy 2.1.3, scipy 1.14.1, pandas 2.2.3, Python 3.12 (1.5.1 has no cp313 wheel). 2238 passed on both sides in every run, 0 in every class, stability 1.0. Guards against false alarms; same dependent and test command as the known-break case.
